task: Predict the repayment risk of a home-equity line of credit applicant (FICO's HELOC data: risk performance Good or Bad, encoded 0/1).
dataset_description: Credit-bureau variables of the applicant. M = months, Num = number of, Percent = percentage of trades (credit accounts); Delq = delinquency, Derog = derogatory, Inq = credit inquiries, Revolving/Install = revolving and instalment trades, Burden = balance relative to credit limit; ExternalRiskEstimate is a consolidated external risk score.
